preconditions.description: The root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The value of the root node must be between 0 and 10^6.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Complete Binary Tree' if return_value else stdout == 'Not Complete Binary Tree'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'Complete Binary Tree' if the function returns true, otherwise 'Not Complete Binary Tree'.
